title: Guess the Lineup
shortDesc: Name an iconic starting XI on an interactive pitch.
description: Fill the 11 starting positions of iconic historic and modern finals using formation, shirt numbers, and tactical clues.

title: Transfer Chain
shortDesc: Trace a player's chronological club path across Europe.
description: Follow the journey from academy roots to European silverware and deduce the superstar behind the transfers.

title: Tactical Breakdown
shortDesc: Analyze formation shapes and core tactical instructions.
description: Read pressing triggers, inverted fullback movements, and rest defense structures to identify the manager or system.

title: Market Value Guessr
shortDesc: Compare valuations in a rapid streak-building showdown.
description: Call whether the challenger is worth more or less than the benchmark player to build your market streak.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe Grid

title: Who Am I?

title: The VAR Call
